|translation='''Title:''' Logistical Delay.

'''Card text:'''
Use 3 Force to deploy on the opponent's side of the table. All of the opponent's TIEs are deploy cost +1.

'''Lore:'''
The Emperor's mighty killing weapon needs fine adjustment at every stage. An unexpected slip in any step can greatly delay the whole deployment plan.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 遅延連鎖 (delay chain).
